positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
* CNCF Operator Framework Chair; 2022; responsible for defining the governance and direction of the Operator Framework project.

* Leading the Operator SDK team, responsible for defining project features, and team assignments. The Operator SDK helps users create Kubernetes Operators (aka controllers).

* Developed the Automation Broker, an implementation of the Open Service Broker API. The Broker managed applications defined in Ansible Playbook Bundles (APBs) enabling users to deploy containerized applications on a Kubernetes or OpenShift cluster.

* Developed the Candlepin project, a service which allowed Red Hat to manage its software subscriptions.

* Developed RHO, a small, SSH-based network inventory tool. RHO scans a user-defined range of machines and then reports basic information about the operating system and hardware about each server.

* Responsible for release duties for many of the projects I’ve worked on including Operator SDK, and Quick Cloud Installer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Former project leader for project Spacewalk, responsible for implementing features, helping users, as well as coordinating project releases.

* Lead developer on Red Hat Network's web team. Key task is to migrate Perl based web UI to Java Struts UI.

* Packaged Java web application using RPM for easy integration with Red Hat Enterprise Linux based servers.

* Developed XML based exception definition system to generate Java exception classes.

* Wrote XML-RPC API for Red Hat Network’s Satellite product.

* Implemented a search server based on Lucene which indexed the database content into a searchable format.

positions.title: Coach
positions.description:
* Coached youth soccer, ages 5 to 12.

* Scheduled, planned and coordinated weekly practices.

* Assistant coach from 2008 to 2010. In 2010, the head coach left, and I took over two soccer teams.

* Continued as head coach until 2015.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead developer of new J2EE architecture using Struts, Eclipse, and JSP using an MVC design pattern.

* Determined feasibility of moving proprietary Java application to J2EE application servers, including WebSphere, WebLogic, and Tomcat.

* Designed and developed B2B applications utilizing Java, XML, HTML, and JDBC supporting both Oracle and SQL Server.

* Became lead developer for catalog and data manager server products after only 7 months with the company.

* Instituted a development process, including design and code reviews, to optimize product quality.

* Developed a persistence framework that allows objects to be stored to a database used in several products.

* Designed and developed a high volume e-mail sender.

* Interfaced with customers on support incidents and occasionally visited customer sites.

* Installed and maintained the development team’s Oracle database and Verity search servers.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Databases · Tomcat · Java Enterprise Edition · XML

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed a C++/CORBA server, Java servlet to build interactive web pages using HTML/JavaScript, and a Java multi-threaded logging service for a distributed, web-based application on Solaris. Responsible for installing and configuring runtime environment.

* Developed a multi-tier web-based database application, running on Solaris. The middle-tier interfaced with the database using the JDBC API, while the front end used RMI to communicate with the middle-tier.

* Designed and implemented a command and control graphical user interface (GUI) utilizing the latest object-oriented design patterns and the RogueWave C++ class libraries– Tools.h++ and View.h++.

positions.title: Lab Technician
positions.description: Responsible for processing 35mm film into negatives, then using them to print customer's photos. Worked full time in the summer months, then on the weekends during the school year.

positions.title: Pre-professional co-op
positions.description: Created an application test bed for the OS/2 Warp operating system. Responsible for testing the Top 100 games of 1994, insuring that the games were recognized properly by the operating system.  Designed and developed test applications for IBM's C Set++ C++ class library.
